findings.detail: Description of "create_post" is 6200 chars, far longer than this server's median (714). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.detail: Description of "create_post" stacks urgency/override words (never, ignore, mandatory). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_workspaces, list_accounts, list_posts, get_post, preview_post, update_post, create_media_upload, list_media, get_analytics, list_queue_slots, list_boards, create_video, get_video, import_app_screenshots · Private data: create_post, upload_media, create_media_upload, attach_media, create_variants, list_boards, platform_limits, create_video, capture_screenshot · Public sink: list_workspaces, list_accounts, get_post, preview_post, create_post, update_post, delete_post, schedule_post, publish_post, confirm_publish, upload_media, create_media_upload, attach_media, create_variants, get_analytics, list_queue_slots, list_boards, platform_limits, create_video, capture_screenshot · Destructive: create_post, update_post, delete_post, upload_media, attach_media, image_formats.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
